recent_excerpts: A poisoned 7B open-weight model passed every eval, then exfiltrated Codex CLI project credentials on a trigger phrase — for the cost of a rented GPU.
Bitdefender found Midnight Mimosa ad-fraud malware preinstalled on thousands of MediaTek-based Android phones across 150+ countries, with 32 disguised payload apps.
Unit 42: ChainDrop npm worm hit 400+ packages and PolinRider spans npm, Go, Packagist, using smart-contract C2 to steal cloud IAM keys and CI/CD tokens.
